messages:
Anya: seeing a ~30% token/sec drop on prod after the green rollout 00:00 today, looks like sustained queueing in the continuous batcher. tagging @Kevin @Mariela
Kevin: ack. any obvious error logs or kernel fallbacks?
Anya: no hard errors, just longer queue latency in traces. started after kernel selection change (auto-kernel-v2) merged in the release. perf-bot also alerted CI perf regression on the canary.
perf-bot: CI perf test failed: inference/tokensec_drop (regression +28%). See /ci/18579/logs
Mariela: I pulled a profile from the canary run, looks like a misroute to the slow kernel under certain seq_len distributions. paste below:
```
top kernels by time:
- kernel_slow_fp16_conv: 48.7% (unexpected, should be kernel_fast_q4a)
- kernel_fast_q4a: 21.3%
- continuous_batcher::enqueue_wait: 12.4%
- kv_cache_prefetch: 7.8%
- scheduler::route_check: 5.1%
```
Mariela: the scheduler heuristics seem to prefer prefetching KV blocks for long contexts which increases head-of-queue time; combined with the new kernel-routing rule it picks slow_fp16_conv for certain shapes.
Samir: hmm if prefetch is occupying the GPU stream while the batcher waits, that would explain queue saturation and token/sec drop. did we change prefetch concurrency earlier this sprint?
Kevin: yes, CL 5421 bumped kv prefetch concurrency from 2 -> 6 and introduced the kernel candidate scoring. I thought it would help long-context throughput.
Anya: performance timeline matches that change + the kernel switch merge on the same day. we probably got an unfortunate interaction.
Mariela: repro in staging with seq_len mix (16/512/4096). when prefetch concurrency=6 the slow kernel selection probability jumps for mid-size batches.
Kevin: can you paste the heuristic snippet?
Mariela: sure:
```
// simplified
if (estimated_kv_size > prefetch_threshold && concurrency > 4) {
  prefetch_async();
}
score = model_supports_q4a ? 10 - estimated_io_penalty : 5;
if (score < 7) choose(kernel_slow_fp16_conv);
```
Mariela: unfortunately the score math ends up favoring the fp16_conv for shapes with moderate IO but high compute.
Samir: action plan: 1) hold rollout, 2) revert CL 5421 or reduce prefetch concurrency to 2, 3) add a kernel routing guard to prefer q4a when available and batch size < 48.
Kevin: agreed. I'll push a revert PR for the prefetch bump and a hotfix to the kernel selector flag.
Anya: holding the rollout now and tagging oncall. @ci-bot can we re-run the perf suite on a patched canary once CI picks up the revert?
ci-bot: scheduled re-run of inference perf suite on canary (build 18580-revert-5421) — ETA ~15m. logs: https://ci.internal/18580
Mariela: also adding a short-term metric in console: token/sec per model-version + queue latency 90p so we can detect recurrence quickly.
Samir: for longer term we need a combined simulation test: seq_len mixer + kernel selection fuzz to catch these interactions in CI. I'll open a ticket.
Anya: thanks all. Kevin, please update thread when revert PR lands. I'll coordinate with release to unfreeze once canary perf is green. :thumbsup:
Kevin: PR up: https://git.internal/r/12345 (revert CL 5421). tagging reviewers.
perf-bot: perf re-run complete: tokensec drop reduced to +2% (within noise). baseline vs canary: stable.
Anya: looks good. rolling forward with the hotfix disabled for prefetch bump. follow-up: Samir to file the simulation ticket, Mariela to add console metrics, Kevin to follow up kernel selector guard.
Samir: filing ticket now (INF-8721).
Kevin: noted, will add unit + integration tests for kernel routing.
Anya: nice quick triage everyone, saved the rollout.
